scenes.title: Shadows Embrace
scenes.outcome: Seraphina bypasses the security and retrieves the scroll.
scenes.consequence: Seraphina learns of Lightbane and the prophecy.

scenes.title: Whispers in the Night
scenes.outcome: Seraphina penetrates the barriers and meets Eldrin.
scenes.consequence: Seraphina learns about the Void and its influence.

scenes.title: The Obsidian Circle's Gambit
scenes.goal: Seraphina discovers the Obsidian Circle's manipulation.
scenes.conflict: Seraphina's reliance on the Obsidian Circle.
scenes.outcome: Seraphina realizes the Circle is manipulating her.
scenes.consequence: Talia's betrayal of Lysander is revealed.
scenes.next_trigger: Seraphina's first corruption of shadow magic.

scenes.title: The Void's Return
scenes.goal: The Void whispers promises to Seraphina.
scenes.conflict: Seraphina's vulnerability to the Void's influence.
scenes.consequence: New threats emerge from the shadows.
scenes.next_trigger: Seraphina must choose between light and darkness.

scenes.title: The Shadowborn's Choice
scenes.outcome: Lysander chooses to remain with the Lumenborn.
scenes.consequence: The Shadowborn must reconcile their darkness with the new era.
scenes.next_trigger: The Whisperwood forest undergoes a transformation.

scenes.title: The Whisperwood's Awakening
scenes.conflict: Eldrin's cryptic words and the Whisperwood's protective barriers.
scenes.outcome: Eldrin reveals the prophecy about Seraphina's fate.
scenes.consequence: New mystical creatures emerge from the shadows.
scenes.next_trigger: The Aetherium Court reveals their true purpose.

scenes.title: The Final Battle
scenes.conflict: The Void's immense power and influence.
scenes.consequence: The fate of Aethelra hangs in the balance.
scenes.next_trigger: Seraphina must find a way to exist in the balance between light and darkness.

scenes.title: The Light's Embrace
scenes.conflict: Seraphina's struggle to reconcile her human and shadow selves.
scenes.outcome: Seraphina accepts her balance of light and darkness.
scenes.consequence: A new era dawns on Aethelra.
